summary: 31 unit test cases across internal/insurance (registry, match, answersheet, checklist, warnings, profile) and internal/cli pass. Behavioral matrix of 10 commands exercised: intake persists profile.json (0600, next-business-day effective date); match routes importer/private-label to specialty markets (Insurance Canopy, XINSURANCE, Veracity, Insureon, Tivly recommended) and pushes mainstream decliners (Hartford, biBerk, Next) to the avoid tier; the inverse non-importer retail profile routes to mainstream instant-quote carriers; answersheet emits paste-ready values ($1M/$2M, decline-marketing, provider hints); checklist surfaces CAPTCHA/account/EIN-SSN/payment/two-gate-submit; warnings surfaces the foreign-products-exclusion (critical) and Coverage B IP gap for importers; guide combines all; doctor validates registry+profile+paths. json/csv/plain/select output modes verified. go build, go vet, gofmt, govulncheck all clean. No HTTP API is wrapped (data-driven guided CLI), so there is no live-API verification step.
